# hetznerrobot_vswitch (Resource)

A vSwitch — a layer-2 network between dedicated servers (and optionally Hetzner Cloud networks). Destroying it cancels the vSwitch, by default immediately; a cancelled vSwitch disappears from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_vswitch" "backend" {
  name    = "backend"
  vlan    = 4000
  servers = [321, 421]

  # Cancelled on destroy; "now" is the default.
  cancellation_date = "now"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the vSwitch.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN id (4000–4091), unique among the account's vSwitches. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `cancellation_date` (String) Used on destroy only: the date (`yyyy-MM-dd`) the vSwitch is cancelled to, or `now` (the default).
- `servers` (Set of Number) Numbers of the servers attached to the vSwitch. Left out, the attached servers are not managed; `[]` detaches all of them. Joining takes a while — the apply waits until every server is `ready`.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the vSwitch is cancelled.
- `cloud_networks` (Attributes List) Hetzner Cloud networks coupled to the vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_networks))
- `id` (Number) Numeric vSwitch id.
- `server_details` (Attributes List) The attached servers with their vSwitch status (`ready`, `in process`, `failed`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_details))
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets routed into the vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_networks`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `id` (Number) Cloud network id.
- `ip` (String) Network address.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.


<a id="nestedatt--server_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_details`

Read-Only:

- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.
- `server_number` (Number) Server number.
- `status` (String) Status of the server in this vSwitch.


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `ip` (String) Network address.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_vswitch.backend 4321
```
